name: Sunshine Raga Vamp
description: Donovan and Mickie Most dominant-7 tonic drone: a static I7-IV7 raga vamp with a IV7-V7-I7 turnaround. In A it is Season of the Witch (A7-D7); in E it is Barabajagal (E7-A7). The dominant-quality tonic is the signature.
source: Donovan + Mickie Most (1966-69), via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets, 12-song aggregate (Sunshine Superman, Season of the Witch, Barabajagal)
